title: Ezekiel 2
paragraphs: ¹ He said to me, "Son of man, stand up on your feet and I will speak with you." ² As he spoke, the Spirit entered me and set me on my feet, and I heard him speaking to me. ³ He said, "Son of man, I am sending you to the people of Israel, to a rebellious nation that has turned against me. They and their ancestors have been in revolt against me to this very day. ⁴ The people are stubborn and hardhearted. I am sending you to them, and you shall say to them, 'This is what the Lord GOD says.' ⁵ As for them, whether they listen or fail to listen — for they are a rebellious house — they will know that a prophet has been among them.

⁶ "And you, son of man, do not be afraid of them or their words. Do not be afraid, though briers and thorns surround you and you live among scorpions. Do not be terrified by their looks, even though they are a rebellious house. ⁷ You must speak my words to them, whether they listen or fail to listen — for they are rebellious. ⁸ But you, son of man, hear what I say to you. Do not be rebellious like that rebellious house; open your mouth and eat what I give you." ⁹ Then I looked, and I saw a hand stretched out to me, holding a scroll. ¹⁰ He unrolled it before me, and it was written on both sides — front and back — with words of lamentation, mourning, and woe.
